relationships.subject: neuropathic pain (SNI)
relationships.evidence_quote: We found higher AMPAR rectification properties when recording from ACC L2/3 pyramidal neurons of SNI mice compared with the sham controls (Figure 2G)

relationships.subject: BLA-ACC projection
relationships.evidence_quote: Altogether, these results indicate that reduction of BLA-ACC activity does not affect approach or avoidance behaviors alone but reduces pain-associated cold avoidance specifically in the face of conflict.

key_findings: SNI mice favor cold avoidance over reward approach in a conflict task, with selective potentiation of BLA inputs onto ACC L2/3 pyramidal neurons.
Inhibiting BLA-ACC projections reduces pain-associated cold avoidance without affecting allodynia.
